turns.query: Identify the air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025. What was the average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact same time (rounded to 1 decimal place)?
turns.actual_response: The air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025, was **Causeway Bay**, with a PM10 reading of **35.7 µg/m³**. import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Find the station with the highest PM10 at 2025-10-05 14:00:00
query = text("""
SELECT hsaq.station_id, aqs.name_en, hsaq.pm10, aqs.coordinate
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
ORDER BY hsaq.pm10 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
df_station = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Station with highest PM10:")
print(df_station[['station_id', 'name_en', 'pm10']])

station_id = df_station['station_id'].values[0]
station_name = df_station['name_en'].values[0]
pm10_val = df_station['pm10'].values[0]
coord_wkt = df_station['coordinate'].values[0]

# Step 2: Find average traffic speed within 500m of this station at the same time
query_traffic = text(f"""
SELECT AVG(hrst.speed) as avg_speed, COUNT(*) as segment_count
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrst.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrst.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
AND ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry::geography,
    (SELECT coordinate::geography FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = {station_id}),
    500
)
""")
df_traffic = pd.read_sql(query_traffic, engine)
avg_speed = df_traffic['avg_speed'].values[0]
segment_count = df_traffic['segment_count'].values[0]

print(f"\nStation: {station_name} (ID: {station_id}), PM10: {pm10_val}")
print(f"Road segments within 500m: {segment_count}")
print(f"Average traffic speed: {avg_speed}")

# Store result
avg_speed_near_pm10 = round(float(avg_speed), 1) if avg_speed is not None else None
print(f"\nRounded average speed: {avg_speed_near_pm10}")
